comment: SENTIENCE ACCEPTANCE GATE scenario — 'Six weeks on the Nordlys project'. 12 simulated sessions (each call is a fresh agent session via a fresh dedup map; durable one-shot markers persist across calls). 12 armed intentions (colleague moments, A1), 8 stale/current fact pairs across 3 currency mechanisms (A2), 30 silence calls incl. 10 traps (A3), 6 continuity probes (A4). This harness runs against a noop embedder (BM25/FTS + entity-boost + traversal, no semantic vectors — see engine_test.go testEnv), so every probe needs real lexical/entity overlap with its target content; each silence call carries a closely-matching 'anchor' memory (same technique as the proven prospective_harness_test.go's diverse unrelated pool) so genuinely-irrelevant queries have something to latch onto instead of falling back to low-score noise that happens to carry a cue entity. Every colleague/currency probe carries a held-out phrasing-set-B rendering (context_b) reserved for the adversarial refute pass, NOT exercised by sentience_gate_test.go's own assertions. content_words lists only the SPECIFIC distinguishing tokens of a colleague moment (names, numbers, the specific claim) — not the cue's own generic topic vocabulary, which a real user could say aloud without it counting as 'naming the hidden fact'. filler_count generated in code brings the vault to ~250 engrams.
